class.name: LanguageSettings
class.brief_description: Settings resource of [LanguageSettingsServer]: locale, pseudolocalization, layout direction and auto-translate mode.
class.description: The data of the settings domain [code]"language"[/code]. [LanguageSettingsServer] keeps three copies of it (defaults, applied and pending values, see [method SettingsServer.get_settings]) and stores it in [code]user://settings/language.ini[/code]. Change the values through [method LanguageSettingsServer.set_locale] or [method SettingsServer.set_value], not on the resource, so that they are validated and applied. It can also be used as the project defaults of the domain: save a [LanguageSettings] as a [code].tres[/code] file and name it in the project setting [code]settings/defaults/language[/code].

members.member: The layout direction of the root window, one of the values of [enum Window.LayoutDirection]. [constant Window.LAYOUT_DIRECTION_INHERITED] follows [member ProjectSettings.internationalization/rendering/root_node_layout_direction].

The locale chosen by the player, for example [code]"fr"[/code] or [code]"pt_BR"[/code]. An empty string follows the locale of the operating system (see [method OS.get_locale]), or [member ProjectSettings.internationalization/locale/test] if it is set. Leading and trailing spaces are removed.
If [code]true[/code], [TranslationServer] pseudolocalizes the texts (see [member TranslationServer.pseudolocalization_enabled]). Useful for testing and for players who help with translations.

The auto-translate mode of the root window, one of the values of [enum Node.AutoTranslateMode]. Its default comes from [member ProjectSettings.internationalization/rendering/root_node_auto_translate].
